name: Apple
about: Apple makes the iPhone, the Mac and the iPad. It also sells apps, music and other services.

name: Microsoft
about: Microsoft makes Windows and Office. It also runs a big cloud, where people rent its computers.

name: NVIDIA
about: NVIDIA designs computer chips. They run video games and AI.

name: Costco
about: Costco runs big warehouse stores. Members pay a yearly fee to shop there and buy in bulk.

name: Nike
about: Nike makes and sells sports shoes, clothes and gear.

name: Amazon
about: Amazon runs a huge online store. It also rents out computer power over the internet.

name: Tesla
about: Tesla makes electric cars. It also makes big batteries for homes.

name: Bitcoin
about: Bitcoin is a digital currency. No company or bank runs it.

name: Ethereum
about: Ethereum is a digital currency. It also runs small programs on its own network.

name: Solana
about: Solana is a digital currency. It also runs small programs on its own network.
